name: Safaricom Data Centre - Nakuru
notes: Specialised Power Systems portfolio lists a Safaricom Data Centre at Nakuru, Kenya and says SPS successfully supplied low-voltage switchboards for the facility to support critical data operations. No public MW capacity found.

name: Olkaria EcoCloud Data Centre / Project Eagle
developer: EcoCloud Data Centre; KenGen Green Energy Park host
notes: DCD reported EcoCloud broke ground on Project Eagle at KenGen Green Energy Park in Olkaria, Nakuru County. Phase one is described as 24MW IT capacity across eight 3MW data halls; article also says the facility is expected to consume 70MW and be powered by geothermal energy from KenGen.

name: Microsoft/G42 Olkaria geothermal data center campus
developer: G42 with Microsoft and local partners
notes: Microsoft's May 22, 2024 announcement says G42 and partners would design and build a geothermal-powered Olkaria data center campus for a new East Africa Azure cloud region. Later DCD reporting says the project targeted an initial 100MW but had stalled over power capacity/contract issues and remained in discussions, possibly scaled back. G42/EcoCloud also announced an Olkaria mega data center collaboration with initial 100MW and potential expansion to 1GW.
